evals.name: atb-boss-two-phase-battle
evals.prompt: hey can you build me a little retro JRPG style battle screen as a single html file? two heroes vs one big boss monster. i want those bars that fill up over time before each character can act, and the boss should switch to a nastier attack pattern once its health gets low. keep it 16-bit looking. no external files, i want to just double click the html
evals.expected_output: Single self-contained HTML with a working ATB battle: gauges pause during menus, boss has an HP-threshold phase change driven by data, dead-target handling, original names only.

evals.name: vertical-slice-town-dungeon-save
evals.prompt: I want a small 16-bit style RPG vertical slice as one HTML file: a tiny town (a shop that buys/sells and an inn that heals+saves), a short 2-floor dungeon with a boss at the end, random battles while walking around, and saving that survives closing the browser tab. Party of 2-3 characters is fine. Keep the scope small but make each piece actually work.
evals.expected_output: One-file playable slice: data-driven content, load-time data validation with visible errors, encounter grace periods, working save/load via localStorage, town+dungeon+boss loop complete.

evals.name: add-magic-system-to-demo
evals.prompt: here's a battle demo html i have (attached as atb-loop-demo.html). can you add a magic system to it? i want it where characters equip some kind of item/relic thing and learn spells from it by earning points in battles, plus elemental weaknesses on the enemies (fire/ice/etc where some enemies absorb or are immune). don't use final fantasy names for anything, make up original ones.
evals.expected_output: Modified demo with an equip-to-learn relic system (data-defined spell lists + point costs), elemental affinity with immune>absorb>resist>weak precedence, original terminology, demo still runs to victory.
